destination.title: Dark-sector production, thermal histories and observational constraints
destination.question: How do particle interactions, production mechanisms and cosmological histories determine dark-sector abundances and observable effects, and which theoretical or observational conditions restrict those possibilities?
destination.summary: A navigational family spanning thermal and nonthermal relics, reheating, radiation and asymmetry generation. Dark-energy mechanisms, microscopic consistency calculations and stellar constraints remain explicit neighboring questions. Ordinary and pre-Swampland work is eligible; neither quantum-gravity motivation nor a nonstandard expansion era is required throughout.

systems: Visible and hidden matter and radiation
Light particles, condensates and dark ensembles
targets: Radiation, BBN, CMB and structure constraints
Adjacent questions about dark energy, microscopic consistency and experimental tests
regimes: Thermal, partially thermalized and nonthermal production
Inflation, reheating, pre-BBN evolution and later cosmological epochs
Separate stellar and laboratory comparison regimes
assumptions: Model, temperature, stability and interaction assumptions remain source-specific
Different mechanisms sharing an observable are not thereby the same scoped question
conventions: Observational statements retain their source dates and dataset choices
Graph relations describe extracted source objects, not automatically physical-question premises
includes: Core cosmological questions and explicitly marked neighboring homes
Compound source questions retained without forced atomization
excludes: A universal thermal history, portal model or dimensional setting
A model-independent test of the Swampland Distance Conjecture
Treating numerical membership as scientific equivalence

sources.title: Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis and Gravitino

evidence.text: How do light-element abundances constrain unstable gravitinos and reheating, or the properties of long-lived NLSPs when the gravitino is stable, after updating production, decay showers and charged-particle bound states?

sources.title: Thermal Relics in Hidden Sectors

evidence.text: Can cosmologically allowed hidden sectors support thermal dark matter with the WIMPless mass–coupling relation, and how do unequal sector temperatures affect radiation constraints, freeze-out and the viable mass range?

sources.title: Cosmological bounds on the 'millicharges' of mirror particles

evidence.text: What cosmological limits on photon–mirror-photon kinetic mixing follow from annihilation heating of a colder mirror sector, distinguishing the BBN and later structure-formation epochs and exact versus spontaneously broken mirror parity?

sources.title: New Light Species and the CMB

evidence.text: How do the couplings of natural, minimal theories containing new light species determine their contribution Δg* to the radiation density at recombination, and what illustrative constraints follow from the paper-era Planck results?

sources.title: The Cosmophenomenology of Axionic Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can rare interactions of energetic, nonthermal axionic dark radiation affect BBN, produce dark matter after thermal freeze-out, and leave an observable cosmic axion background?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, Nonthermal Dark Matter and Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can constraints on nonthermal MSSM neutralino dark matter determine the duration of a post-inflationary matter-dominated phase and thereby sharpen predictions for the scalar tilt and tensor-to-scalar ratio?

sources.title: The Moduli and Gravitino (non)-Problems in Models with Strongly Stabilized Moduli

evidence.text: Under what stabilization and reheating conditions can a heavy Polonyi sector avoid excessive entropy production and gravitino-mediated neutralino overproduction, while possibly supplying the dark matter abundance?

sources.title: The Darkness of Spin-0 Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can scattering of scalar or pseudoscalar dark radiation off the pre-recombination plasma generate observable CMB spectral distortions and thereby discriminate dark-radiation models beyond their relativistic energy density?

sources.title: Dark matter production mechanisms with a nonthermal cosmological history: A classification

evidence.text: How can relic dark-matter production be classified and its abundance approximated when a pre-BBN modulus-dominated era reheats visible and dark sectors with potentially different temperatures?

sources.title: Nonthermal production of dark radiation and dark matter

evidence.text: Can nonthermal production reconcile dark matter with detectable visible-sector interactions and sufficiently cold dark radiation, while generating both baryonic and dark matter asymmetries?

sources.title: Light Higgsino Dark Matter from Non-thermal Cosmology

evidence.text: Can late reheating after an early matter-dominated era yield the observed abundance of light higgsino dark matter, and what detection prospects and string moduli mass hierarchies support this possibility?

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter from Strongly-Coupled Dark Sectors

evidence.text: Can dark ensembles with Regge spectra and exponentially growing Hagedorn degeneracies realize the abundance–lifetime balancing required by Dynamical Dark Matter, and what initial cosmological restrictions follow from their aggregate abundance and effective equation of state?

sources.title: General Constraints on Dark Matter Decay from the Cosmic Microwave Background

evidence.text: Can CMB anisotropy constraints on broad classes of dark-matter decay spectra be compressed into one model-dependent detectability parameter, calibrated with a reference likelihood analysis, and extended to shorter-lived subdominant or metastable species?

sources.title: A small amount of mini-charged dark matter could cool the baryons in the early Universe

evidence.text: Can a small electrically minicharged dark-matter component cool baryons during cosmic dawn sufficiently to deepen 21-cm absorption while satisfying the constraints reviewed by the paper?

sources.title: Room for New Physics in the Rayleigh-Jeans Tail of the Cosmic Microwave Background

evidence.text: Can numerous, very soft nonthermal dark photons enhance the CMB Rayleigh–Jeans photon count without violating the constraints considered, and thereby produce a detectable 21 cm signature or explain the then-tentative unusually strong EDGES absorption?

sources.title: Constraining Non-thermal Dark Matter by CMB

evidence.text: Can the minimum early-matter-domination duration needed to obtain the dark-matter abundance with ⟨σann v⟩<3×10^(−26) cm³ s^(−1) be reconciled with inflation-dependent upper limits from the scalar spectral index?

sources.title: Parametric Resonance Production of Ultralight Vector Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can a displaced dark Higgs transfer its condensate energy into vectors through parametric resonance early enough to produce ultralight dark matter satisfying relic-abundance and coldness constraints?

sources.title: Anomalous EDGES 21-cm signal and a moduli dominated era

evidence.text: Can freeze-out during an early modulus-dominated era, followed by entropy dilution, reconcile photon-mediated millicharged DM with the fractional abundance needed in the paper's EDGES interpretation?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How does time variation of a weak connection between a dark Abelian sector and hypercharge affect dark-matter production?

sources.title: MeV-scale reheating temperature and thermalization of oscillating neutrinos by radiative and hadronic decays of massive particles

evidence.text: What lower reheating-temperature bounds follow from BBN when initially dominant long-lived particles decay radiatively or hadronically, with neutrino oscillations and neutrino self-interactions included in thermalization?

sources.title: Cosmological Bounds on sub-GeV Dark Vector Bosons from Electromagnetic Energy Injection

evidence.text: What constraints do BBN photodissociation and CMB power and frequency spectra place on long-lived sub-GeV dark vectors when detailed electromagnetic injection spectra, nonuniversal cascades and thermal freeze-in production are included?

sources.title: The First Three Seconds: a Review of Possible Expansion Histories of the Early Universe

evidence.text: Which departures from radiation domination are physically motivated, how do they affect relics and primordial structure, and what observations constrain them before or after BBN?

sources.title: Nonthermal hot dark matter from inflaton or moduli decay: Momentum distribution and relaxation of the cosmological mass bound

evidence.text: How does the nonthermal momentum distribution of sterile particles produced during an early matter-to-radiation transition affect CMB and linear matter spectra, and how much can it relax the physical mass constraint on a subdominant hot dark matter component?

sources.title: Gravitino thermal production revisited

evidence.text: What gravitino thermal production rate follows after correcting earlier analytical and numerical treatments of the one-loop thermal self-energy, and what abundance and reheating constraints follow?

sources.title: Hidden photon and axion dark matter from symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can the thermal breaking of a hidden continuous symmetry produce sufficiently cold light axion-like or hidden-photon dark matter through dark-Higgs oscillations, once Higgs-portal interactions, thermal blocking, and dissipation are included?

sources.title: Polynomial inflation and dark matter

evidence.text: Can a minimal renormalizable extension of the Standard Model jointly realize small-field inflation, Higgs reheating, and the observed abundance of nonthermal fermionic dark matter, without a nonminimal gravitational coupling?

sources.title: Dark radiation constraints on portal interactions with hidden sectors

evidence.text: How do CMB dark-radiation bounds constrain renormalizable portals through massive SM-singlet mediators, including production out of equilibrium, and when can constraints be estimated independently of hidden-sector details?

sources.title: Beyond the Standard Model Cocktail

evidence.text: Can entropy dilution permit thermal or would-be thermal dark matter substantially above the standard freeze-out mass bound, and can cosmic-string gravitational waves probe the associated early matter or vacuum domination?

sources.title: Swampland bounds on dark sectors

evidence.text: Can a weakly coupled non-Abelian dark-radiation bath interact with thermal WIMP dark matter to alter cosmological expansion and matter clustering while producing correlated collider and annihilation signatures?

sources.title: Axion-like Dark Matter Mediators

evidence.text: Can a weakly coupled DFSZ-like axion-like mediator reproduce the observed dark-matter abundance while dark matter remains thermally decoupled from the Standard Model, and which experimental constraints probe the viable production regimes?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Specify component equations of state and initial densities, integrate conservation separately, sum densities, and integrate the Friedmann equation. Equality epochs follow by equating component densities rather than by assuming continued single-component dominance through the transition.

sources.title: Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis and Gravitino

evidence.text: Follow decay chains with ISAJET/ISASUSY and simulate hadronization with PYTHIA. Vary standard and nonstandard reaction rates by Monte Carlo; combine theoretical and observational errors in quadrature in the χ² analysis.

sources.title: Thermal Relics in Hidden Sectors

evidence.text: CalcHEP supplies annihilation cross sections for hidden neutrino and gauge-boson final states. Thermal averaging uses modified Bessel functions and a nonrelativistic expansion retaining a0 and a1. Generalized analytic S-wave freeze-out formulas interpret the numerical solutions.

sources.title: Cosmological bounds on the 'millicharges' of mirror particles

evidence.text: Diagonalize and canonically normalize photon kinetic terms to identify effective ordinary charges of mirror particles. Calculate e+e− → e′+e′− production and use a thermal average involving modified Bessel functions and the Møller velocity at low temperature.

sources.title: New Light Species and the CMB

evidence.text: Construct collision functionals from leading 2-to-2 processes, including Bose enhancement or Pauli blocking. The displayed collision formula assumes time-reversal-invariant processes and averages squared amplitudes over incoming and outgoing spins.

sources.title: The Cosmophenomenology of Axionic Dark Radiation

evidence.text: For the present spectrum, distribute exponential modulus decays over production times and redshift their energies using a numerical matter-to-radiation transition. Continual matter domination and continual radiation domination supply early- and late-decay analytic approximations.

sources.title: Current Constraints on Cosmological Scenarios with Very Low Reheating Temperatures

evidence.text: What lower limits on MeV-scale reheating follow from primordial abundances, CMB anisotropies and BAO when incomplete neutrino thermalization, spectral distortions and prior dependence are treated consistently?

sources.title: Hot new early dark energy: Towards a unified dark sector of neutrinos, dark energy and dark matter

evidence.text: Can a supercooled thermal dark-sector transition supply early dark energy and generate sterile-neutrino masses through an inverse seesaw, while yielding falsifiable active-neutrino and dark-temperature constraints and admitting a high-energy dark-matter embedding?

sources.title: Saturon Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can maximal microstate entropy enable direct quantum production of macroscopic dark matter from homogeneous thermal radiation, and enhance finite-temperature bubble nucleation?

sources.title: What is the lowest possible reheating temperature?

evidence.text: How low can the reheating temperature be when light-element abundances are combined with CMB and large-scale-structure constraints, including a direct decay channel from the reheating particle into neutrinos?

sources.title: On Effective Degrees of Freedom in the Early Universe

evidence.text: How can effective degrees of freedom for number density, energy density, pressure and entropy describe Standard Model cooling, particle annihilations, the QCD transition and neutrino decoupling?

sources.title: Narrowing the window for millicharged particles by CMB anisotropy

evidence.text: How do millicharged particles coupled to baryons at recombination alter CMB anisotropy, and how tightly can historical WMAP data combined with a BBN baryon prior constrain their abundance and remaining mass-charge window?

sources.title: MeV scale reheating temperature and thermalization of neutrino background

evidence.text: How late can massive-particle decay restore radiation domination while preserving successful BBN, accounting for incomplete neutrino thermalization and possible hadronic decay products?

sources.title: Dark Energy in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a cool, internally thermalized hidden sector hold a light scalar away from its zero-temperature minimum and thereby provide present dark energy?

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?

sources.title: Cosmological constraints on late time entropy production

evidence.text: How low can the reheating temperature after late decay of massive particles be while remaining compatible with BBN, once incomplete neutrino thermalization is calculated explicitly? What additional signatures arise in large-scale structure and CMB anisotropies?

sources.title: Dark Matter meets Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Which minimal thermal dark-matter models admit an asymptotically safe gravity–matter embedding, and what restrictions do the resulting Planck-scale boundary conditions place on low-energy portal couplings and dark-matter masses?

sources.title: Moduli induced cogenesis of baryon asymmetry and dark matter

evidence.text: Can late modulus decay generate both visible baryon asymmetry and asymmetric dark matter at GeV-scale reheating, while conserving baryon number at the fundamental vertices and explaining ΩDM/ΩB ≈ 5?

sources.title: Schwinger dark matter production

evidence.text: Can inflationary Schwinger production alone generate the observed dark matter abundance, including light charged particles whose purely gravitational production is negligible, in a secluded dark sector that never thermalizes?

sources.title: Baryogenesis from Gravitational Decay of TeV-Particles in Theories with Low Scale Gravity

evidence.text: Can gravitational decays of nonthermal TeV-mass particles generate the cosmological baryon asymmetry when low-scale gravity forces reheating below temperatures suitable for conventional electroweak or GUT baryogenesis?

sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Can thermal dark matter reproduce the assumed observed abundance with annihilation cross sections larger or smaller than standard-cosmology values, through scalar-tensor modifications of pre-BBN expansion?

sources.title: Reheating in small-field inflation on the brane: The Swampland Criteria and observational constraints in light of the PLANCK 2018 results

evidence.text: Can lepton production after inflation and subsequent sphaleron conversion explain the quoted cosmological baryon asymmetry for the inferred reheating temperatures?

sources.title: Dark matter from mediator decay in early matter domination

evidence.text: How strongly does production from thermal on-shell mediator decays constrain dark matter in histories containing early matter domination, particularly when production occurs during its adiabatic stage or an earlier radiation era?

sources.title: Early dark sector, the Hubble tension, and the swampland

evidence.text: Can cosmological bounds on a scalar-dependent dark-matter mass challenge an SDC-motivated early-dark-energy model when the fraction of coupled matter is not fixed by the conjecture?

sources.title: Generality and persistence of cosmological stasis

evidence.text: How general and persistent is matter-to-radiation cosmological stasis across the full space of species decay rates and initial abundances, and which spectra favor longer duration beyond previously studied power-law models?

sources.title: Dark Radiation constraints on minicharged particles in models with a hidden photon

evidence.text: How do production, partial thermalization and decoupling of minicharged fermions and massless hidden photons determine dark radiation during BBN and recombination, and constrain their masses and couplings?

sources.title: Dark dimension gravitons as dark matter

evidence.text: Can gravitational production from a hot Standard Model brane supply viable dark matter in the dark dimension, while relating its abundance to the dark-energy scale?

sources.title: Dark matter of any spin -- an effective field theory and applications

evidence.text: Can massive particles of arbitrary spin be treated perturbatively using only physical components, and can a neutral Higgs-portal realization account for dark matter through freeze-out or freeze-in while satisfying the bounds used in the paper?
